model.form: negative binomial NB2, offset ln(km x years)

pir_range_m.provenance: WildSight README 3.2 (PIR 15-20 m, assumed) and SIM_CONFIG.pirRange = 17

spacing_m.provenance: design: two 17 m PIR zones plus overlap give continuous roadside coverage; wider spacing leaves gaps between units

sides.provenance: design: animals approach from both shoulders

standby_wh_day.provenance: WildSight README 4 daily energy budget with motion wake

gateway_range_km.provenance: design: LoRa at roadside height reaches about 2-5 km in rural terrain; every unit within range of a solar gateway with cellular backhaul (WildSight README 9.2, 11)

unit_hardware.provenance: design assumption: bill of the README 3.2 proposed parts (edge-AI board and camera, PIR, ultrasonic transducers, amber beacon, 6 W panel, 40 Wh LiFePO4, enclosure)

unit_install.provenance: design assumption: guardrail clamp, sign-post strap or ground stake (README 10), crew time and traffic control

gateway_installed.provenance: design assumption: pole-mounted solar LoRa gateway with LTE-M modem

backhaul_per_gateway_month.provenance: design assumption: IoT cellular data plan

cloud_per_unit_year.provenance: design assumption: event store, fleet health and DOT dashboard (README 9.2)

maintenance_per_unit_year.provenance: design assumption: about one service visit a year (README 10)

effectiveness.provenance: assumption. FHWA 2008 Report to Congress: animal detection with driver warning cut large-animal collisions 82% on average at seven Swiss sites; WildSight's own effect is unproven (README 13)

crash_cost_usd.provenance: Huijser et al. 2009 (Ecology and Society 14(2):15) average deer-vehicle collision cost $6,617 in 2007 USD, x 1.55 CPI-U 2007 to 2025 (approximate); applied to every reported animal crash

unreported_factor.provenance: 1 = police-reported crashes only (conservative); carcass surveys find several times more collisions than crash reports

crash_snap_m.provenance: design: crash reports are geocoded to about 100 m (Signal Four verification levels)

aadt_join_m.provenance: design: an OSM segment takes the FDOT count of the section within 40 m

default_aadt.provenance: design defaults by OSM class where FDOT has no count (FDOT counts state highways only)

default_speed_mph.provenance: design defaults by OSM class where OSM has no maxspeed

default_lanes.provenance: design defaults by OSM class where OSM has no lanes tag

sources.crashes: Animal-Related Vehicle Collisions 2014-2024, University of Florida Center for Landscape Conservation Planning (D. Smith, C. Gagne), from Signal Four Analytics crash reports
sources.hotspots: Large Animal-Vehicle Collision Hotspots 2014-2024 (Getis-Ord Gi*), UF CLCP for FDOT
sources.aadt: FDOT Transportation Data and Analytics, Annual Average Daily Traffic (2025)
sources.device: WildSight, Engineering Innovation Team 7, University of Florida (github.com/jayrosen-design/wildsight)
